title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-15
source: Sony Stereo ECM -->SONY TCD126 Location: TBD

ai_review.summary: Rough‑sounding recording captures a stellar setlist from the Dead's prime era.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that the audio is a bit rough around the edges, suggesting the source isn’t pristine, but still praises the concert as featuring one of the best setlists of the band’s classic period. The performance itself is highlighted for its era‑defining quality, making it worth listening despite the modest recording fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments about the setlist and era outweigh the minor sound issues; with only one review, confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as a little rough, indicating some lack of clarity or polish.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer calls the setlist one of the best they've ever heard, emphasizing its overall strength and flow.
